label: V8 (isolated-vm)
notes: An instance is one isolated-vm Isolate (memoryLimit 128 MB) plus one context, created and evaluating 1 + 1 synchronously.
Memory: resident growth of the Node host across 200 live instances, after two forced GCs before and after.
Start: median of 40 creates after 3 warm-ups.

Tool call: v8_op.mjs. The guest starts each call with a synchronous host call and awaits a promise that the host resolves from the same thread, as deno_core ops do. Median of per-batch means, 20,000 calls in batches of 100 after 2,000 warm-ups; 9.21 µs of CPU per call.

The same call through isolated-vm's async API costs 40.65 µs (cpu_bench.mjs), and 49.86 µs when the host answers on a later event-loop turn (inproc.mjs); a fully synchronous applySync call costs 4.79 µs.
Compute: one isolate (memoryLimit 1024 MB) runs the task through applySync; the host times each call, which copies the JSON text in and the result text out.
